compare_tensors_eq: compare two Crypten MPCTensors for equality using the eq function
compare_tensors_lt_gt: compare two Crypten MPCTensors using less than or greater than comparison
compute_tensor_sign: compute the sign value of a Crypten MPCTensor where zero is considered positive
apply_relu_to_tensor: apply the Rectified Linear Unit activation function to a Crypten MPCTensor
select_with_where: select elements from one of two tensors based on a boolean condition using where
